domains.directory_rules: nearest AGENTS.md; results/README.md is the explicit evidence-operations exception

projections.README.md: landing page with environment setup only
projections.AGENTS.md: routing, constraints and research-classification discipline only
projections.docs/agent/*.json: paths, ids, bindings and verification without independent research claims
projections.docs/PAPER.md: section tasks, figure status and unresolved writing dependencies; link factual owners rather than duplicate designs, results or historical reviews
projections.docs/agent/records/: immutable historical measurements and verdicts; corrections use superseding records
projections.docs/references/: dated external-source notes, not project mechanisms or novelty verdicts; MiniCPM-o 4.5 worked-example parameters are maintained in minicpm-o-4.5-kv-geometry.md
projections..claude/: local tool settings only; project instructions are rooted in AGENTS.md, with no parallel role-memory layer
projections.eurosys2027/planning/: submission checklist and AI-use disclosure only; research tasks live in docs/PAPER.md or their factual owners
